presentation.limits: Historical tape uses checked selected-symbol patches and full-file strict replay; the browser applies no matching or venue allocation. All-price marks are capped by the visible grid and overflow is counted. Flow trails are summarized; timestamp playback is not network latency. Other browser engines are untested.
